text: Automates recurring subscription billing, custom pricing plans, and billing periods like trials and renewals
quote: Use Stripe Billing to manage subscriptions and invoicing. It automates recurring payments, creates custom pricing plans, and handles billing periods, such as trials and renewals.

text: Create subscriptions via the Dashboard or the Subscriptions API
quote: Create a new subscription in the Dashboard or with the Subscriptions API.

text: Set up usage-based pricing models for SaaS products
quote: you can set up and integrate different types of usage-based pricing models with your SaaS product.

text: Preview proration amounts before applying subscription changes
quote: You can preview a proration to view the amount before applying the changes.

text: Automatically retries failed subscription/invoice payments to reduce involuntary churn
quote: Smart Retries: Automatically retry failed payments to prevent involuntary churn due to temporary issues.

text: Automated support for global accounting standards to simplify revenue recognition
quote: Simplify your revenue recognition with automated support for global accounting standards

text: Create, customize, and send hosted invoices from the Dashboard with no code
quote: Create, customize, and send a Stripe-hosted invoice from the Dashboard, with no code required.

text: Grant or revoke customer access to product features based on plan
quote: Determine when you can grant or revoke product feature access to customers.

text: Import existing subscriptions from third-party billing systems like Zuora, Recurly, Chargify, or Chargebee
quote: You can import existing subscriptions from third-party billing systems (such as Zuora, Recurly, Chargify, or Chargebee) into Stripe Billing.

text: Dashboard view to monitor overall billing performance at a glance
quote: Monitor overall performance at a glance

text: Customer portal lets customers self-manage their billing account
quote: Give your customers the ability to manage their account by setting up a customer portal.

text: Trial Offer API manages both free and paid introductory subscription periods
quote: Use the Trial Offer API to manage both free and paid introductory periods for your subscriptions with a single API integration.

text: Automates sales tax, VAT, and GST compliance across transactions
quote: Automate sales tax, VAT, and GST compliance on all your transactions.

text: Pushes real-time event data (webhooks) when account events occur
quote: Stripe pushes real-time data to it when events happen in your Stripe account.

text: Provides a guided multi-step process to migrate customer and payments data into Stripe
quote: Migrating your customer and payments data to Stripe is a multi-step process.

text: Official MCP server lets AI agents interact with the Stripe API
quote: Let your AI agents interact with the Stripe API by using our MCP server.

text: Official CLI to build, test, and manage a Stripe integration from the command line
quote: Build, test, and manage your Stripe integration from the command line.
